name: showreel-c3-eiffel-tower

voice.text: Why was the Eiffel Tower almost torn down? It was built for the 1889 World's Fair. At 300 metres, it was the tallest structure on Earth. But Eiffel's permit lasted only twenty years. In 1909, the city could tear it down. So Eiffel found it a new job. In 1903, he let the army test radio from the top. Soon its signals crossed the Mediterranean. Too useful to lose, it was saved in 1910. And it is still on air today.

caption:
In 1909, Paris could have torn down the Eiffel Tower. A radio antenna saved it. 📻
